Headline: Shangrila Development Bank announces auction for its unsold right shares; Auction opens for 9 lakh unit right shares from Chaitra 13
Full Content:
Shangri-la Development Bank Limited (SADBL) has announced auction for its unsold 9,01,997.50 unit right shares. The auction will start from Chaitra 13 and end on Chaitra 20, 2074.

The right share issue was open from Poush 17, 2074 to Magh 29, 2074. The bank had issued 1,08,67,798.50 unit right shares in the ratio 10:8 in the par value of Rs 100 each. 11,732 shareholders were allotted 99,65,801 unit right shares on Chaitra 04, 2074.

3,52,772.50 unit right shares from the promoters group and 5,09,225 unit right shares from the ordinary shares group are available in the auction. Bidders must quote a minimum price of Rs 100 per unit, which means that the lowest bid amount must be more than Rs 100.Interested bidders must bid for a minimum of 100 units of shares.

Prabhu Capital Limited has been appointed as the issue manager for the auction. Interested bidders can collect bid forms from Prabhu Capital Limited or from the designated branches of Shangrila Development Bank.

The bank has urged the bidders to deposit the bid amount in the A/c Number 13511600631816000005 of Prabhu Bank Limited in the name of Prabhu Capital Limited or A/C no 02500800186243000001 of Shangrila Development Bank in the name of Prabhu Capital Limited. The bidders can also apply using Good for Payment Cheque.

The current paid up capital of SADBL is Rs 1.35 arba. After the issuance of right share, the paid up capital will reach Rs 2.44 arba.

Headline: Shangri-La Development Bank completes its orientation program for 55 new employees
Full Content:
Recently Shangri-La Development completed its 10 days’ orientation program for the newly appointed employees. The orientation program was aimed at socializing the employees and informing them regarding various works performed by the bank and its rules and regulations.

According to the press release, the training was attended by 50 employees, where they learnt about computer system, credit and customer service, teller management, identifying fake notes, signature verification etc.
On the same notice, the deputy CEO of the bank, Mr. Dinesh Thakali mentioned that the bank will also establish a learning center in the near future for employee development. The bank will soon be inaugurating 22 new branches in different parts of the country and after that the bank will have a network of 58 branches altogether.

Headline: Book closure for 80% right shares of Shangri-la Development Bank on Mangsir 27; only 5 trading days left
Full Content:
Shangri-la Development Bank Limited (SADBL) has published notice regarding book closure date for upcoming 80% right share issue.

SADBL will be issuing 80% right shares to its shareholders at Rs 100. Prabhu Capital Limited has been assigned as issue manager for the right share issue.

Headline: Shangri-la Dev Bank's AGM rejects acquisition of Nepal Community Dev Bank; Paid up capital to reach Rs 2.44 arba after 80% right share
Full Content:
Shangri-la Development Bank Limited (SADBL)'s 12th AGM held on Jestha 19, 2074 has disapproved the final agreement and acquisition deal with Nepal Community Development Bank Limited (NCDB). Now, Shangri-La Development Bank will be acquiring Cosmos Development Bank Limited (CSDBL) only.

Earlier, Shangri-la Development Bank had signed an initial agreement with Cosmos Development Bank (1 district level development bank) and Nepal Community Development Bank (1-3 district level development bank) for acquisition. Trading of Nepal Community Development Bank was suspended in Nepal Stock Exchange Limited (NEPSE) on Poush 21, 2073.

Also, the bank has endorsed 80% right share in its AGM agenda after acquisition process. The bank is now seeking final approval from Nepal Rastra Bank for the acquisition of Cosmos Development Bank. Since the acquisition process with NCDB has been cancelled, the paid up capital of Shangri-La after acquiring Cosmos Development Bank will be Rs 1.35 arba. On that capital, the company will issue 80% right share i.e Rs 1.08 arba, after which SADBL's paid up will reach Rs 2.44 arba.

As per NRB's monetary policy, SADBL should increase its paid up capital to a minimum of Rs 2.50 arba by the end of FY 2073/74. After the issuance of 80% right share, the bank should issue a further Rs 6 crore capital increment.

Likewise, Nepal Community Development Bank Limited will now be endorsing 120% right share since its acquisition with SADBL has been rejected. After capitalization of 120% right share, NCDB's paid up capital will reach Rs 51.35 crore.
